summary: This component renders a blog post item with optional series navigation. It checks whether we're viewing a single blog post page or a list, and if we're on a single post page, it shows a SeriesPosts component both above and below the main content to help readers navigate related posts in the same series.

explanations.12: This helper function determines what CSS class to apply to the container — it adds bottom margin spacing when viewing the post in a list, but removes that spacing when viewing a single post page where it's not needed.
explanations.13: useBlogPost() is a hook from Docusaurus that gives us metadata about the current blog post context, including a flag that tells us whether we're viewing the full post page or just a preview in a list.
explanations.21: clsx is a utility that combines multiple CSS class names together, ignoring any that are undefined — so it smartly merges the container spacing class with any additional classes passed in.
explanations.24: This conditional rendering means the SeriesPosts component only shows when isBlogPostPage is true, so readers only see the series navigation when they're reading the full post, not when browsing a list.
